newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt forecasts 97/98 budget to grow 7.5 pct. [corrected 13:31 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Egypt forecasts 97/98 budget to grow 7.5 pct. [corrected 13:31 gmt]

text.p: Egypt forecast its 1997/98 budget would be 83.792 billion pounds ($24.68 billion), 7.5 percent higher than the 77.5 billion (corrects from million) pitched for the current 1996/7 year which ends on June 30, official figures showed.
Parliament approved the budget figures on Wednesday.
The state said it expected 76.398 billion pounds ($21.62 billion) of revenue during 97/98, which raised the budget deficit to 6.84 billion pounds from 6.3 billion in 96/97.
